title: Cognos Report Execution Failures
dataSources: MicroStrategy DSSErrors/statistics, Cognos audit database via DB Connect, BusinessObjects Auditing/CMS logs, Oracle Analytics usage tracking, ThoughtSpot audit logs, QuickSight CloudTrail and SPICE CloudWatch metrics.
app: MicroStrategy / IBM Cognos / SAP BusinessObjects / Oracle Analytics / ThoughtSpot / Amazon QuickSight logs via Universal Forwarder, vendor admin APIs, and cloud provider TAs (`Splunk_TA_aws` for QuickSight).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=cognos:audit action=RunReport
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(status="Failed")) as failures by report_path
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/runs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Uses the Cognos audit database to rank reports by execution failure rate, exposing broken reports and unreliable data sources.
value: Failed Cognos runs waste analyst time and erode trust; ranking by failure rate points at the reports to fix first.
implementation: Query the Cognos audit DB via DB Connect; schedule hourly; alert on high failure rates.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of run failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch Cognos reports and flag the ones that keep failing to run so they get fixed.
